+}
+TEXT_SUFFIXES = {
+    ".py", ".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".jsx", ".mjs", ".cjs", ".json",

+    ".c", ".h", ".html", ".css", ".graphql", ".proto", ".sh",
+}
+MAX_FILE_BYTES = 80_000
+MAX_TOTAL_BYTES = 600_000
+MAX_FILES = 150

+def github_url(value: str) -> str:
+    if not re.fullmatch(r"https://github\.com/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/?", value):
+        raise AnalysisError("use a public repository URL: https://github.com/owner/repo")
+    parts = value.rstrip("/").split("/")[-2:]
+    if any(part in {".", "..", ".git"} for part in parts):
+        raise AnalysisError("invalid GitHub repository URL")
+    return value.rstrip("/")
+

+def clone(repo_url: str, destination: Path) -> None:
+    url = github_url(repo_url)

+        subprocess.run(
+            ["git", "-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null", "-c", "credential.helper=",
+             "clone", "--depth=1", "--single-branch", "--", url, str(destination)],
+            env=env, capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=60,
+        )
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
+        raise AnalysisError("GitHub clone timed out after 60 seconds") from exc
+    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as exc:
+        raise AnalysisError("GitHub clone failed; check the URL, public access, and network") from exc
+    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
+        raise AnalysisError("git is required to clone a GitHub repository") from exc
+
+
+def project_root(root: Path, subdir: str) -> Path:
+    root = root.resolve()
+    target = (root / subdir).resolve()
+    if not target.is_relative_to(root) or not target.is_dir():
+        raise AnalysisError("subdir must be an existing directory inside the repository")
+    return target
+

+def collect_files(root: Path) -> dict:
+    root = root.resolve()
+    if not root.is_dir():
+        raise AnalysisError("repository path must be an existing directory")
+    candidates = []
+    for directory, dirs, files in os.walk(root):
+        dirs[:] = sorted(d for d in dirs if not d.startswith(".") and d not in SKIP_DIRS
+                         and not (Path(directory) / d).is_symlink())
+        for name in sorted(files):
+            path = Path(directory) / name
+            if (name.startswith(".") or name in SKIP_FILES or path.is_symlink()

+            if path.suffix.lower() not in TEXT_SUFFIXES and name not in {"Dockerfile", "Makefile"}:
+                continue
+            if any(word in name.lower() for word in ("secret", "credential", "private_key")):

+            candidates.append(path)
+
+    # Manifests and README first; the remaining source files have stable ordering.
+    candidates.sort(key=lambda p: (p.name.lower() not in {
+        "readme.md", "package.json", "pyproject.toml", "requirements.txt", "go.mod",
+    }, p.relative_to(root).as_posix()))
+    selected = []
+    skipped = []
+    total = 0
+    for path in candidates:
+        relative = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
+        size = path.stat().st_size
+        if size > MAX_FILE_BYTES or total + size > MAX_TOTAL_BYTES or len(selected) >= MAX_FILES:
+            skipped.append(relative)
+            continue
+        raw = path.read_bytes()
+        if b"\x00" in raw:
+            continue
+        try:
+            content = raw.decode("utf-8")
+        except UnicodeDecodeError:

+            continue
+        selected.append({"path": relative, "content": content})
+        total += len(raw)
+    if not selected:
+        raise AnalysisError("no supported source or documentation files found")
+    return {"files": selected, "omitted_files": skipped}

+    from google import genai
+    from google.genai import types

+    api_key = os.environ.get("GEMINI_API_KEY", "").strip()
+    model = os.environ.get("GEMINI_MODEL", "").strip()
+    if not api_key or not model:
+        raise AnalysisError("set GEMINI_API_KEY and GEMINI_MODEL in the local .env")
+    try:
+        with genai.Client(
+            api_key=api_key,
+            http_options=types.HttpOptions(timeout=90_000, retry_options=types.HttpRetryOptions(attempts=1)),
+        ) as client:
+            response = client.models.generate_content(
+                model=model,
+                contents=build_prompt(bundle, role),
+                config=types.GenerateContentConfig(
+                    system_instruction=SYSTEM,
+                    response_mime_type="application/json",
+                    response_schema=CodebaseAnalysis,
+                    temperature=0.2,
+                ),
+            )
+        result = CodebaseAnalysis.model_validate_json(response.text or "")
+    except Exception as exc:
+        # SDK exceptions can contain request data: don't expose their raw text.
+        raise AnalysisError(f"Gemini analysis failed ({type(exc).__name__}); check model access, quota, and connectivity") from exc
+    paths = {file["path"] for file in bundle["files"]}
+    for item in [*result.technologies, *result.project_areas, *result.questions]:
+        if not set(item.source_files).issubset(paths):
+            raise AnalysisError("Gemini cited a file that was not included in its input")
+    return result
+

+def question_docs(result: CodebaseAnalysis) -> dict[str, str]:
+    docs = {}
+    for index, generated in enumerate(result.questions, 1):
+        fields = [generated.question, generated.answer, generated.context]
+        if any(not value.strip() or re.search(r"(?m)^\s*#{1,2}\s", value) for value in fields):

+        context = generated.context + "\n\nSource files: " + ", ".join(f"`{p}`" for p in generated.source_files)
+        doc = f"# Question\n{generated.question}\n\n# Answer\n{generated.answer}\n\n# Context\n{context}\n"
+        loader.parse_question(f"q{index}", doc)
+        docs[f"q{index}.md"] = doc
+    return docs

+# Codebase context extraction agent
+
+Gemini reads the source files, identifies technologies and project areas, and
+generates three generalized questions about project experience, optimization,
+and trade-offs. Candidates do not need to have read the repository.
+
+The Python code only collects files, calls Gemini once, validates the result,
+and saves it. There is no separate manual codebase analysis or vector database.
+
+From the repository root:
+
+```sh
+uv venv --python 3.12 .venv
+uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -r requirements.txt
+```
+
+Fill in `GEMINI_API_KEY` and `GEMINI_MODEL` in the root `.env`. The local `.env`
+is gitignored. Use a Gemini model available to your API key that supports
+structured output, for example `gemini-2.5-flash`.
+
+Analyze the local demo:
+
+```sh
+.venv/bin/python -m src.analysis --path demo-proj --role "Backend Engineer"
+```
+
+Or shallow-clone a public GitHub repository. Use `--subdir` if the project lives
+inside a larger repository:
+
+```sh
+.venv/bin/python -m src.analysis \
+  --repo-url https://github.com/e-left/SuperhumanResources \
+  --subdir demo-proj --role "Backend Engineer"
+```
+
+The command prints the session ID and parsed questions. It writes:
+
+```text
+data/<session_id>/context.json
+data/<session_id>/questions/q1.md
+data/<session_id>/questions/q2.md
+data/<session_id>/questions/q3.md
+```
+
+`context.json` contains the summary, technologies, project areas, optimization
+topics, questions, and the file coverage. Each question document contains
+`# Question`, `# Answer`, and `# Context`, including source paths. Add the actual
+candidate profile as `data/<session_id>/candidate.md` before starting the voice
+interview at `/?session=<session_id>`.
+
+The FastAPI app also exposes `POST /analyze` with
+`{"repo_url": "https://github.com/owner/repo", "role": "Backend Engineer", "subdir": ""}`
+and `GET /sessions/<session_id>/questions`.
+
+Collection skips hidden files/directories (including `.env` and `.git`), obvious
+credential filenames, symlinks, vendored/generated files, and lockfiles. It sends
+up to 150 supported text files, 80 KB per file, 600 KB total. Budget exclusions
+are listed in `context.json`; this is a bounded sample for large repositories.
+File filtering is not a general secret scanner: source text is sent to Gemini.
+No repository code is executed. Clone and Gemini requests have 60 and 90 second
+timeouts respectively; failed Gemini calls are not retried automatically.
+
+Tests run offline with a mocked Gemini response:
+
+```sh
+.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_analysis.py
+```
